response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT tr.transreg AS transreg, tr.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist), g AS (SELECT t.*, AVG(t.avg_short) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS grp_avg FROM t) SELECT transreg AS transaction_reference, ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, avg_short AS avg_short_interest_days_to_cover, avg_opt AS avg_option_volume_ratio, avg_short * 1.0 / NULLIF(grp_avg, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM g ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
